answer: One defense is proof-of-unique-entropy. Each seat must feed a shared randomness beacon a freshly sampled stream from its own quartz oscillator thermal jitter, pooled Yarrow-style and stamped to a per-epoch nonce. Clones on one machine draw from the same crystal, so their streams correlate along an identical drift ridge and collapse into a single seat. Running N real agents then demands N separately powered physical entropy sources, a recurring hardware cost no copied key can fake.
